CREATE TABLE `memberships` (
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `plan_code` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `billing_period_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `expiration_kind` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `expires_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_state_observed_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `origin` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `imported_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_membership_expiry` (`expiration_kind`,`expires_at_utc`,`user_id`),
  KEY `fk_membership_migration` (`migration_run_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_membership_migration` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_membership_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_expiration` CHECK ((((`expiration_kind` = _utf8mb4'no_expiry') and (`expires_at_utc` is null)) or ((`expiration_kind` = _utf8mb4'at_time') and (`expires_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_origin` CHECK ((((`origin` = _utf8mb4'legacy_import') and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)) or ((`origin` = _utf8mb4'native') and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_plan` CHECK ((`plan_code` in (_utf8mb4'free',_utf8mb4'plus',_utf8mb4'pro'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
